title: Joseph Butler's nickname Kid Twat and birth in Algiers
summary: Butler explains his nickname, says he was born in Algiers in 1907, and talks about buying his bass and about Louis Armstrong and Red Allen.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Stop it Paul, she can't fix it. Okay. Alright. What's your name? My name is Joseph. That's not what everybody calls you. They call me Kid Twat from the Boothwaite.

Well where the Boothwaite come from? I was up in St. Paul, Minnesota. I left there. I came on down there to St. Louis. Where I was then. They used me. I was taken right from my own hometown. And then what they call me then? Kid Twat from the Boothwaite. Why they call me that? Because I was a cigarette tester. Cigarette tester. Where were you born? I was born right here on the next street. I was right there where I came out. In Algiers. Al J is right where I am young now. On the next street I'm on the Homer Street and the next street is Newton. And I still live there. And where were you? What year? I was born in 1907. Exact day? Oh man. I can't cause for Louis Armstrong. Red Allen. We all played together. This is how I told you before. And them boys is going to let me. Why? I didn't have a daddy to do. Teach me. When I first bought my bass. What he did. He shot at me with his shotgun. But he skipped me. Ha ha. He skipped me. Cause I was ducking. I wanted that way. I paid my money off. I was waiting for tuition water board. And boy I was getting $12 a week. I mean $21.60 a week. One week I give my mama $60. And the next week I give my mama $11. And I keep the $10.60. Next week I keep the $10.60. You see? But old Red Allen was playing. You couldn't hear him when he was playing. They call him Biffley. They call him Biffley. And then we used to sit on the corner. We used to look at him coming. And then he'd say. I said. I said. Look at the old man coming. He said. Let him come a little closer. Let him come a little closer. Everybody take me for Louis. Yeah. Louis is my cousin. And anytime Louis come anywhere around the city. The area of New Orleans. He'd come and see twat from the bourgeois. Why'd he call me twat from the bourgeois? Because I was up in St. Louis. And he was brought down.

Well I told you that once. Because I tell you why. They used to call me Turk. Turkey Buzzard. Turkey Buzzard. Why? I used to name him Dark and Hansel. But man when I started to pick on that bass. Them cats let me go. I used to sit down. Everybody used to play the piano. I said. Now I'm going to get me something different. I said. Let me play a little piece once in a while. He said. No man. I said. I just got you. Well I said. I'm going to get me something to myself. I got on and I prayed. I said. Lord. What can I get for them guys who keep from knowing me. And I started to. And I made me a little string. They come. Toot. Toot. Toot. Toot. And I used to hold bass for Louis. I'm. Oh. Chris Kelly and all them. Still get rang. And old. All them boys right now. I don't know what they call them.
